:::{#def-profile-loglik}
#### Profile log-likelihood

Split a parameter vector into $(\psi, \lambda)$,
and for each fixed value of $\psi$
let $\hat\lambda(\psi)$ maximize $\ell(\psi, \lambda)$ over $\lambda$.
The **profile log-likelihood** of $\psi$ is

$$\ell_p(\psi) \eqdef \ell\paren{\psi, \hat\lambda(\psi)}.$$

:::
